Real classrooms rarely match that picture. To find out where the gap actually sits, we watched real users test EdTech products on their own entry-level mobile devices, in field studies across Kenya, South Africa, and Rwanda. We found that an EdTech product can look good on a fully charged demo laptop, but real-world deployment tells a radically different story. In our observations, up to 75% of participants struggled with foundational web mechanics, such as multi-tab navigation or copy-pasting text, before ever interacting with the instructional material.
